title: GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Weekly Charts
description: Rockstar Games' unusual move to debut an extended look at GTA 6 on Netflix paid off, pulling in 31.1 million views to top the weekly charts.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Weekly Charts

The hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster *GTA 6* continues to reach unprecedented heights. In a somewhat unusual marketing strategy, Rockstar decided to debut an extended look at the highly anticipated title exclusively on Netflix last week.

While the video eventually made its way to YouTube and other conventional sources, the subscription streaming service secured a six-hour head start. According to recent metrics, that exclusive window has paid off remarkably well for both parties.

## Record-Breaking Streaming Numbers

Data from Netflix's weekly Top 10 charts reveals that the *GTA 6* video was comfortably the most-watched title globally by a significant margin. Between August 27th and August 30th, the extended look accrued an impressive 31.1 million views.

This staggering viewership underscores the massive global appetite for any new footage from the game, while also highlighting the success of blending major gaming announcements with mainstream streaming platforms.

## A New Era of Gaming Marketing

Rockstar Games is no stranger to breaking records with trailer drops, but partnering with Netflix for a timed exclusive debut marks a fascinating shift in how AAA game marketing can operate. By leveraging Netflix's vast, mainstream subscriber base, the collaboration successfully captured the attention of both hardcore gamers and casual entertainment consumers alike.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games continues to prove that they write their own rules when it comes to game promotion. Giving Netflix a six-hour exclusive window for the new *GTA 6* footage was a bold gamble that clearly paid off, pulling in 31.1 million views in just a few days and reminding the entire industry of the game's unmatched cultural footprint.
